question: Must access tokens be kept confidential in transit and storage?
answer_1: Yes, access tokens must not be transmitted in the clear, meaning they must be kept confidential in transit. This requirement is specified in Section 10.8.

Furthermore, access tokens must not be transmitted in the clear and must be transmitted using TLS (Section 10.3, Section 10.8).
